# `ext::server_poll` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/server_poll.lani#L2)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

One shared typed, caller-driven server scheduler and synchronous facade own bounded admission, cooperative fair progress, poll publication, reservations, cancellation and acceptance-order reports. Seventeen scripted profiles execute the actual Server: seven earlier owner/publication/refill/reservation profiles, three populated owned E/A profiles in 13.60 seconds and seven active-cap/cancellation profiles in 13.42 seconds. The no-Destroy empty-report helper control is separate (21.84 seconds). Four actual plain/TLS 1.3 causal cases pass held setup with queued refill and held 4 MiB backpressure, real EAGAIN, sibling progress, closure/reports and two-owner/three-socket caps. Current plain groups pass matrix 30/quota 1/limits 16/boundaries 25/faults 41: 113 process-case invocations, including quota overlap, with 23 reached source OOM positions. HTTPS/mutual-TLS regressions separately pass 102/101 cases. Both 64-connection scale observations pass demand eight/caps four plus five and exact 64 KiB bodies/reports; source requested-byte peaks 1,165,325/1,352,377 exclude native heaps, bootstrap, kernel memory and RSS. A separate actual plain-driver gate passes two reached poll-fault cases and one calibration, not two more scripted profiles. EINTR requires fresh publication and recovery without stale readiness; EIO publishes shared PollIo(5), cleans up live owners and preserves the caller listener. The retry reuses the compiled ELF and has no elapsed-time claim. Rare native TLS WANT/clock and mixed invalid/valid mutual-TLS concurrency schedules retain finite gaps. Reply.stage copies handler-local backing during the call; request views cannot escape to retired-slot reports. Listener/factory/handler backing remains borrowed through Server destruction, while borrowed error backing must outlive returned/taken outcomes. Logical reservations are not RSS, native crypto CPU or heap quotas. Worker threads remain separate work.
